# Camera

> Camera shake and FOV tweens.

- Package: `Camera` · Category: Client systems
- Starts at server boot: only when picked; otherwise the first time game code uses it
- Installing it also installs: nothing else (only Core)
- Check it is installed: `GaxiaServer.IsInstalled("Camera")` on the server; `Gaxia.IsInstalled("Camera")` on the client

## `Gaxia.Camera`

- Runs: **client only (LocalScript / client ModuleScript)**
- Source: `src/ReplicatedStorage/Gaxia_Packages/Client/CameraController.lua`

Get it:

```lua
local Gaxia = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Gaxia_Packages)
local Camera = Gaxia.Camera
```

### Functions

- `Camera.GetCamera(): Camera`
- `Camera.Shake(intensity: number, duration: number): ()`
  Shakes the camera for `duration` seconds. `intensity` is the largest turn of the camera in DEGREES (pitch and yaw, at the start; not studs): 0.5 is a light bump, 2 a hit, 5 an explosion. The shake decays LINEARLY toward zero — linear gives the cleanest "punch then settle" feel. A new Shake replaces the current one.
- `Camera.SetFOV(fov: number, duration: number?): ()`
  Tween-based FOV change. Cancels any prior in-flight tween so a fast pair of calls (e.g. ADS in → ADS out) doesn't blend at half-way and look mushy.
- `Camera.ResetFOV(duration: number?): ()`
  Convenience wrapper; same tween path so it cancels in-flight changes cleanly.

### Fields

- `Camera.OnShakeStarted = OnShakeStarted`
- `Camera.OnShakeEnded = OnShakeEnded`
